h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Chittoor

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Chittoor

c: Chittoor is a district town in the far south of Andhra Pradesh, close to the Tamil Nadu and Karnataka borders and within reach of Tirupati. The district is known for its mango orchards and granite. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Chittoor to schools, colleges, temple and trust properties, municipal parks and residential layouts. We manufacture at our Vasai factory, about 950 km away, and deliver by road.

Much of the ground around Chittoor is rocky, with granite close to the surface in many places. That shapes how the machines are fixed. On rock we cut shallow pits and grout the posts in, and on hard, level paving some machines can stand on their own base. The climate is dry and hot for most of the year, with rain from both the southwest and the northeast monsoon. Dust and sun are the main things the equipment has to handle.

richText.heading: Machines for a temple or trust property

c: Temple and trust properties often have staff quarters, guest houses and open grounds where an open gym gives staff and visitors a place to exercise. The
is a sturdy fixed frame for pull-ups and dips. The
lets two people work the shoulders at once. Choose a spot away from the main paths used by large groups of visitors.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 950 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can outdoor gym machines be installed on rocky ground?
items.a: Yes. On granite or hard rock we cut pits for the posts and grout them in concrete. On firm, level paving some machines can be self-standing. We confirm the method from your photos.

items.q: Do you supply temple trusts and institutions?
items.a: Yes. Send the site size, photos and the type of users to sales@funplaysystems.com. We will reply with a suggested set, a layout drawing and a quote.

items.q: How do we look after the machines in dry, dusty weather?
items.a: Wipe seats and handles regularly, sweep dust from around the pedals and footplates, and check bolts every few months. Our after-sales team can supply spares.
